learning_outcomes.text: Explains the basic concepts of failure analysis, mechanisms and phases.
Learns about the types of failure and the testing methods of failured parts.
Prepares the failure analysis report and proposes solutions to prevent the damage.

syllabus_topics: Introduction. Definition of failure. Stages of failure analysis.
Failure types. Plastic, elastic distortion. Fracture. Micromechanism of the crack's progress .
Fracture mechanics. Determination of the crack's origin. Fracture for tensile loadings and other loading cases.
Fatigue. Crack propagation. Fatigue regions. Fatigue limit.
Images of fracture surfaces. Fatigue damage analysis. Application examples.
Corrosion. Chemical and electrochemical corrosion. Types of corrosion.
Prevention of corrosion. Corrosion damage analysis. Application examples.
Stress corrosion. Stress corrosion susceptibility of various materials. Stress corrosion damage analysis. Application examples.
Hydrogen embrittlement. Reasons for formation. The necessary precautions.Failure analysis of hydrogen embrittlement. Application examples.
Creep. High-temperature strengths and deformations of metals. Creep mechanisms. Creep failure analysis. Application examples.
Friction, wear. Lubrication. Types of wear.
bibliography: Materials Science and Engineering, William D. Callister, David D. Rethwisch, Wiley
Eryürek, Prof. Dr. B., Failure Analysis, Faculty of Mechanical Engineering, İTÜ, Birsen Publishing, 1993, İstanbul.
